name: maverick-mcp-auditable-tax-lot-transactions-bcef
instr:
Maverick cannot yet preserve acquisition lots or audit disposals and realized performance.

Keep ordered lots, aggregate shares, remaining basis, allocations, proceeds, and realized P&L exactly reconciled in Decimal arithmetic for each canonical ticker. Disposals must deterministically use `LotSelectionMethod.FIFO`, `LotSelectionMethod.LIFO`, or `LotSelectionMethod.SPECIFIC`; insufficient selected shares must change nothing. Isolate history by user and portfolio, order it by commit sequence regardless of trade date, and allow optional canonical-ticker filtering.

Make acquisition, disposal, clearing, realization, and optional journal association atomic. Failures must leave no partial portfolio or journal state. Clearing closes every open lot in one commit while retaining auditable history and journal links. Snapshots and analysis must separate cumulative realized P&L from unrealized performance on surviving basis. Risk views must use that basis, excluding disposed lots, proceeds, and realized profit from current exposure.

Existing add calls must record acquisitions and return the same aggregate position results. Existing remove calls must perform lot-aware disposals, return removal results, and reject unavailable selected quantities without mutation. Preserve existing add, remove, clear, snapshot, analysis, risk, and MCP boundaries, live-price fallbacks, success and error envelopes, empty results, and annotations when lot controls are omitted. MCP tools must support disposal
